details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:134-149 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack can emit V2 chains whose total chunk count exceeds MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST, but the extractor rejects those chains.
  WHY: The write path has no upper-bound check, so oversized packs produce unreadable V2 state and force fallback to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:393-409 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: _extract_state_payloads keeps the oldest duplicate V2 chunk, while production cmd_extract keeps the newest one.
  WHY: The helper walks comments oldest-first with setdefault, so tests can validate a different snapshot than production on retry/repost cases.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:after line 6821 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The claimed regression tests for oversized pack rejection and duplicate V2 part handling are absent.
  WHY: Without those tests, the two issues above can regress without detection.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1130-1142 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The V2 payload size guard can fail open when wc -c output is invalid or partial, allowing oversized data to fall back to V1.
  WHY: That leaves the poller’s only 8 MiB check bypassable and can expose stale or oversized state.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:216-265 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: cmd_extract reads comments without pinning UTF-8, so non-ASCII data can raise UnicodeDecodeError under non-UTF-8 locales.
  WHY: A locale-dependent decode failure would force an unexpected V1 fallback and make extraction depend on runner locale.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:212-234 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: verify_integration_fingerprints drops identical (path, regex) pairs from both must_contain and must_not_contain.
  WHY: That can hide exact-match contradictions in --list-violated-files instead of surfacing them.
- scripts/detect_editor_changes_lost.sh:62-93 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The reference-clause stripping regex can consume later edit claims in multi-edit bullets.
  WHY: A bullet like "Edit A. This matches B. Edit C." can collapse to "Edit A.", producing false EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST results.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:575-610 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS is not clamped against the 60-minute step budget.
  WHY: An oversized override can let one attempt exhaust the step and prevent retries.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:136 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack computes the chunk count but never rejects totals above MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST.
  WHY: The extractor rejects such chains, so the writer can emit unreadable V2 state and force fallback to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:~409 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _extract_state_payloads walks comments oldest-first and uses slot.setdefault(part, chunk), so the oldest duplicate part wins.
  WHY: Production cmd_extract walks newest-first with the same setdefault pattern, so retry/repost cases are resolved differently in tests and prod.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:108-160 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack does not validate total against MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST before writing.
  WHY: The extractor rejects totals above 1024, so pack can emit unreadable V2 chains and force stale V1 fallback.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:408-409 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _extract_state_payloads makes the oldest duplicate V2 chunk win, unlike production.
  WHY: The helper uses forward iteration plus setdefault, while cmd_extract is newest-wins, so tests can validate the wrong snapshot.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:end of file (line 6821) | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed regression tests for oversized pack rejection and duplicate V2 handling are missing.
  WHY: Without those tests, the above bugs can regress undetected.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:134-149 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack computes the total chunk count but does not validate total <= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST before emitting chunk files.
  WHY: A large state file or small chunk size can produce an unreadable V2 chain that the extractor rejects, forcing fallback to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:409 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _extract_state_payloads walks comments oldest-first with slot.setdefault(part, chunk), so the oldest duplicate part wins.
  WHY: Production cmd_extract walks newest-first with the same setdefault, so retry/repost scenarios resolve differently in tests and prod.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:after line 6821 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed regression tests for oversized chunk rejection and duplicate V2 part handling are absent from the file.
  WHY: Without them, the two bugs above can regress without detection.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1130-1142 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The V2 payload size guard still falls back to V1 on measurement failure, so a corrupted or hostile oversized payload could slip through.
  WHY: The 8 MiB guard is the only protection, and any bypass of it is a reliability risk.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:136 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack computes the total chunk count but never checks it against MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST before writing the manifest and chunk files.
  WHY: If total exceeds 1024, the extractor rejects the resulting V2 chain and the poller falls back to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:409 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test helper walks comments oldest-first and uses setdefault, so the oldest occurrence of a duplicate V2 part wins.
  WHY: Production cmd_extract walks newest-first with the same setdefault behavior, so the helper validates a different snapshot than production.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:137-149 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack emits manifests with total > MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST=1024 without rejection.
  WHY: The extractor rejects such chunks, rendering the written V2 chain unreadable and forcing fallback to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:350-409 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Forward oldest-first walk plus slot.setdefault(part, chunk) keeps the oldest duplicate chunk.
  WHY: Production cmd_extract uses reversed(newest-first) order with setdefault, so tests can validate the wrong snapshot on retry/repost.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1130-1142 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: wc -c failure, empty output, or non-numeric output bypasses the 8MiB V2 payload cap check.
  WHY: A malformed manifest can feed an unbounded payload into extraction and risk poller OOM or state poisoning.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:216-265 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No explicit UTF-8 pin exists on json.loads(comments_path.read_text()).
  WHY: A non-UTF-8 runner locale can raise UnicodeDecodeError on non-ASCII comment content and force a silent V1 fallback.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:212-234 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: list_violated_files drops both must_contain and must_not_contain for shared (path, regex) keys without warning.
  WHY: Pre-codex expansion can silently skip files with exact-match contradictions instead of surfacing them.
- scripts/detect_editor_changes_lost.sh:62-93 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The greedy sed pattern on reference clauses can strip trailing edit claims from multi-edit bullets.
  WHY: "Edit A. This matches B. Edit C." can collapse to "Edit A.", which can produce false-positive EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST blocks.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:575-610 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS has no clamp against the 60-minute step timeout.
  WHY: An oversized override can let the first attempt consume the whole step budget and skip retries.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:~6821+ | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed regressions for oversized V2 rejection and duplicate-part handling are missing from the test file.
  WHY: The autofix summary claims tests were added, but they are absent, so the bugs can regress undetected.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:137 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack calculates the number of chunks without checking whether total exceeds MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST.
  WHY: A large state snapshot or tiny chunk size can produce a V2 chain that writes successfully but can never be read back.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:409 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test helper walks comments oldest-first and uses setdefault, which keeps the first occurrence.
  WHY: Production cmd_extract walks newest-first with the same setdefault semantics, so the test can validate a stale snapshot.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:end of file (after line 6821) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed regression tests for oversized chunk rejection and duplicate V2 part handling are not present in the file.
  WHY: Without them, the two bugs above can regress without detection.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
